model.designDecision: A versioned finite outcome registry supplies substantive reality changes and one substantial composite. These examples are not the maximum possible power of Wish. Additional outcomes need their own explicit design/version and tests, not an invented universal permission. No D&D spell-copy ceiling, gold cap, stress, Strength drain, spell-loss chance, extra material price or cooldown is imported.
model.admission: Select an exact registered outcome and complete finite argument graph. All affected bodies/items/source and destination geometry must be within120ft and satisfy the selected LoE/permission rules. Known impossible/unregistered/prohibited declarations are rejected before commitment; hidden defenses/changed versions discovered after commitment are paid failures with no refund.

WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.operation: Instantaneously change owned nonliving mundane material into a specified mundane material and shape, conserving exact total mass for this outcome; this is not a global Wish conservation limit.
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.inputs: source IDs, quantities, material/density, owner consent, output blueprint/density/volume and unoccupied supported destination cells
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.exclusions: living tissue, souls, unique relic identity/protected components, knowledge/history and resource pools are not authorized by this outcome
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.result: new physical geometry/material with one lineage graph and original ownership. Source quantities are consumed exactly once; no ongoing magic or free reversion.

WISH-STRUCTURE-RECONSTRUCT-01.operation: Reconstruct a finite damaged mundane structure from its exact authorized blueprint and real compatible mass, including its support graph and exact durability. It may use the staged output of MATERIAL-RESHAPE in the same composite.
WISH-STRUCTURE-RECONSTRUCT-01.rules: validate all source/target/support versions and full empty-volume fit. No restoring consumed unique resources, reviving destroyed relic powers or inferring an unavailable blueprint. Completed construction is ordinary physical aftermath.

WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.operation: Instantaneously relocate a finite explicitly enumerated set of willing living corporeal creatures and their currently declared carried items between exact cells on the same plane. No fixed participant-count cap; every body and its complete cargo envelope must be enumerated and independently fit.
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.consent: each creature explicitly consents at commitment and settlement; each moved independent owned item has lawful custody/owner permission
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.geometry: both original and destination complete bounds within120ft with clear LoE from caster; destination supported and pairwise nonoverlapping; actual anti-teleport/source protections remain effective
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.cost: caster's paid Wish supplies the relocation; no recipient movement cost or extra Action is fabricated, and no recipient budget is refreshed
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.preserve: actor identity, HP/Wounds/death history, current RP, concentration, existing elapsed clocks, item ownership/charges and all prior movement spent; process actual range-dependent effect callbacks once

composite.transaction: One cast, one Action, one actual final RP price; stage every node against a versioned projected state, validate all nodes and protections, then atomically commit the entire graph. No partially built bridge or moved participant exists if any node fails. The dependency graph is evidence, not three free new spell casts.
composite.failure: Known-invalid graph refused at admission. Counterspell/changed consent/version/occupied endpoint after commitment leaves all original world nodes untouched and preserves cast costs/history. Staging rollback is distinct from audit inverse of the full paid branch.
composite.deduplication: castID:operationGraphHash is the transaction key; receipt-first repeat returns original result with no second quantities, relocation, procs, memory or cost. Concurrent distinct casts race via version checks, never last-writer duplication.
composite.ongoingOrDeferred: None in these three outcomes. Save/load or later dispel does not rewind physical results. Future outcome versions must explicitly define any ongoing or deferred source, deadline and terminal ordering.

fixture.site: TEST-ONLY-ARENA-11 with the same exact bridge gap/support geometry declared by the Divine Intervention fixture; this is a fresh isolated branch, not imported Divine events

sourceMaterial.material: mundane mixed aggregate allowed by this NEW reshape recipe

relocation.cargo: one10lb1Load owned pack per evacuee, exact contained/attached bounds
relocation.destinationFloor: continuous test-floor at z=0 outside gap

model.extensionPolicy: A future registered substantive Wish outcome is allowed to exceed these examples if separately and explicitly authored; this package neither claims unlimited success nor imposes these examples as native power ceilings. Existing Hunt, time/history, uniqueness and source-protection qualifications remain.
